description: This file defines the ChannelResourcesApiController class within the Goteo application, responsible for handling API requests related to channel resources, including validation of resources and uploading images via AJAX.

classes.name: ChannelResourcesApiController
classes.description: Controller for managing channel resource-related API endpoints, including resource validation and image uploads.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the controller, setting up database replica and cache behaviors.

methods.name: validateNodeResources
methods.description: Validates that a resource with given tab and id exists and that the user has permission to access it.

methods.name: uploadImagesAction
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to upload images related to channel resources.
